{{External|rs|rsc=Black Scimitar}} {{Infobox Item |name = Black scimitar |image = [[File:Black scimitar.png]] |release = [[30 April]] [[2002]] |update = Latest RuneScape News (30 April 2002) |members = No |quest = No |tradeable = Yes |equipable = Yes |stackable = No |noteable = Yes |options = Wield, Drop |examine = A vicious, curved sword. |value = 768 |weight = 1.814 |respawn = 1500 |exchange = Yes |id = 1327 }} [[File:Black scimitar detail.png|left|140px]] The '''black scimitar''' is a [[scimitar]] with a slightly higher attack bonus than the [[steel scimitar]]. It requires level 10 [[Attack]] to wield. A black scimitar can be found in [[King Lathas]]' [[Ardougne Castle|castle]] in [[East Ardougne]]. The respawn rate of a black scimitar here is about 12 minutes and 30 seconds. It requires level 61 [[Thieving]] to access. It can also be bought from [[Briget's Weapons]]. As with all [[Black equipment|black]] and [[white equipment]], the black scimitar cannot be made from raw materials using the [[Smithing]] skill. ==Combat stats== {{Infobox Bonuses |astab = +4 |aslash = +19 |acrush = -2 |amagic = 0 |arange = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = +1 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |drange = 0 |str = +14 |rstr = 0 |mdmg = 0 |prayer = 0 |slot = weapon |speed = 4 |attackrange = 1 |combatstyle = Slash Sword |image = [[File:Black scimitar equipped male.png|120px]] |altimage = [[File:Black scimitar equipped female.png|120px]] }} {{CombatStyles|Slash Sword|speed=4|attackrange=1}} ==Money making== {{Mmgsection|Collecting black scimitars from Ardougne Castle}} ==Item sources== {{Drop sources|Black scimitar}} ===Spawns=== {{ItemSpawnTableHead}} {{ItemSpawnLine|name=Black scimitar|location=[[Ardougne Castle]] ({{FloorNumber|uk=1}})|members=Yes|plane=1 |2572,3284|leagueRegion=Kandarin}} {{ItemSpawnTableBottom}} ===Shop locations=== {{Store locations list|Black scimitar}} ==Used in recommended equipment== {{Used in recommended equipment|Black scimitar}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |date = 13 June 2005 |update = RuneCraft Update and Tweaks |change = The item's examine was changed from "''A vicious curved sword.''" to "''A vicious, curved sword.''" }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Black scimitar detail (beta).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Black scimitar detail.png|center|300x150px]] |- |[[File:Black scimitar (beta).png|center]] |[[File:Black scimitar.png|center]] |- |RuneScape 2
